answer_raw:
The latest Claude models are **Claude Fable 5.2** and **Claude Mythos 5.2** (undated) [2], while the latest ChatGPT model is **GPT-6.1 Terra** (2026-10-26) [1].

**Claude Fable 5.2** and **Mythos 5.2** are Anthropic's most capable models for technical work, generating outputs **30% faster** than their predecessors and offering improvements in coding, reasoning, and vision (2026-11-09) [4]. **Mythos 5.2** is restricted to organizations in Anthropic's Life Sciences and Cyber verification programs (2026-11-09) [4].

**GPT-6.1 Terra** focuses on delivering fast and capable computer use at scale (2026-10-26) [1]. While ChatGPT has seen significant expansion in advertising and enterprise availability (2026-10-21, 2026-11-09), Claude has seen a recent influx of users migrating from ChatGPT (2026) [1, 3].

I would use **Claude** for coding. **Claude Opus 4.6** became the coding model to beat in 2026, and the **Claude Code** agentic environment provides exceptional reasoning, multi-file handling, and terminal access for complex refactors (2026) [3].
